title: Zenith Nutty Chinese Pork Bao
description: A nutty and pillowy Chinese dish featuring whole milk and air-fried pork, served in a terracotta dish. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
Gradually add in whole milk and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
In a separate bowl, mix together ground pork, chopped scallions, chopped walnuts, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of pork filling in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges.
Place the bao in a terracotta dish and air fry at 375 degrees for 12 minutes.
